ज: ज 1. ज, the third letter of the second or palatal class of consonants, having the sound of ज् in जुम्प्. —ज-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound ज।

ज 2. ज, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. जन्, and used at the end of comp.), born from, descended from, a son or daughter of, produced or caused by, born in, produced in or at or upon, growing in, living at, being at [cf. अत्रि-दृग्-ज, धृतराष्ट्र-ज, आत्म-ज, अण्ड-ज, कुल-ज, वन-ज, सरसि-ज, अग्र-ज, अवर-ज, एक-ज, &c.]; prepared from, made of or with; belonging to, connected with, peculiar to [cf. अन्न-ज and शक्र-ज]; (अस्), m. a father, pro-genitor; birth, production; [cf. जा।]

ज 3. ज, अस्, आ, अम् (connected with the preceding by some lexicographers, but the meanings appear to be artificial), speedy, swift; victorious, triumphant, conquering; eaten; (अस्), m. speed; enjoyment; light, lustre; poison; a Piśāca; a N. of Viṣṇu; also of Śiva; (आ), f. a husband's brother's wife.
ज|उ जऌहु, उस्, उस्, उ (related to जड ?), Ved. deprived of splendor or without sacrificial fire.
जंस्: जंस् जंस्, cl. 10. P. जंसयति, -यितुम्, to protect; to liberate.
जंह्: जंह् जंह्, Ved. only in Intens. जङ्गहे, to strike with the wings or feet, to kick; (Sāy. who derives this word from ग्रह्), to hold tight, hold fast.
जंहस्: जंहस्, अस्, n., Ved. flapping of the wings; (Sāy.) velocity, speed; [cf. कृष्ण-जंहस्।]
जक: जक जक, अस्, m., N. of a Brāhman.
जकुट: जकुट जकुट, अस्, m. a dog; the Malaya mountains; (अम्), n. a pair; (अस्, अम्), m. n. the egg-plant, Solanum Melongena, or its flower.
जक्ष्: जक्ष् 1. जक्ष् (probably a reduplicated form of घस्, q. v.), cl. 2. P. जक्षिति, 3rd pl. जक्षति (Gram. 290. ब्); Impf. अजक्षीत् and अजक्षत् (Pāṇ. VII. 3, 98, 99), 3rd pl. अजक्षुस्; जजक्ष, जक्षिष्यति; Aor. अजक्षीत्, 3rd pl. अजक्षिषुस्; जक्षितुम् or जग्धुम्, (Pres. part. nom. sing. m. जक्षत्, Pāṇ. VII. 1, 78), to eat, consume, destroy; to wish to eat: Caus. जक्ष-यति, अजजक्षत्: Desid. जिजक्षिषति: Intens. जाजक्ष्यते, जाजष्टि।
जक्ष् 2. जक्ष् (reduplicated fr. rt. हस्), cl. 2. P., Ved. जक्षिति, &c., to laugh.
जक्ष् जक्ष, अस्, m. a Prākṛt form for यक्ष।
जक्षिवस्: जक्षिवस्, आन्, उषी, अत् (perf. part. fr. rt. घस्), one who has eaten.
जग्ध: जग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, eaten; (अम्), n. a place where a person has eaten. —जग्ध-पाप्मन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. one whose sin or wickedness is consumed or blotted out.
जग्धि: जग्धि, इस्, f. eating, consuming; food, victuals; [cf. कल्य-जग्धि।]
जक्ष्म: जक्ष्म, अस्, m. and जक्ष्मन्, आ, m. two Prākṛt forms for यक्ष्मन्।
जगत्: जगत् जगत्, अत्, अती, अत् (reduplicated form fr. rt. गम्), moving, movable, locomotive, transitory; (त्), n. that which moves or is alive, men and animals, or animals as opposed to men; (in the later language) the world, the earth, the universe; (ती), n. du. heaven and the lower world; जगन्ति, n. pl. the worlds; (त्), m. air, wind; (ती), f. a female animal, a cow, (metaphorically ‘milk, water’); the earth; the site of a house; people, mankind; the world, the uni-verse; a particular metre consisting of four lines of twelve syllables each; a general name for any metre containing 4 × 12 syllables; a sacrificial brick named after the metre Jagatī; a field planted with Jambū. —जगच्-चक्षुस्, उस्, m. ‘the eye of the universe,’ the sun. —जगच्-चन्द्रिका, f., N. of a commentary by Bhaṭṭotpala on the work Vṛhaj-jātaka; (this com-mentary is also called Cintā-maṇi.) —जगच्-छन्दस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, one to whom the metre Jagatī belongs, or to whom it is chiefly addressed &c. —जगज्-जीव, अस्, m. living in the world, a living being. —जगज्-जीवन-दास, अस्, m., N. of the author of three poems entitled Jñāna-prakāśa, Prathama-grantha, and Mahā-pralaya. —जगती-धर, अस्, m. ‘supporter of the world,’ a mountain; N. of a Bodhi-sattva. —ज-गती-पति, इस्, m. ‘lord of the earth,’ a king. —ज-गती-पाल, अस्, m. ‘earth-protector,’ a king. —जगती-भर्तृ, ता, m. ‘supporter of the earth,’ king. —जगती-भुज्, क्, m. one who enjoys or possesses the earth, a king. —जगती-रुह, अस्, m. ‘growing on the earth,’ a tree. —जगती-वराह, अम्, n., N. of a Sāman. —जगत्-कर्तृ, ता, m. the creator of the world; Brahmā. —जगत्-कारण, अम्, n. the cause of the universe. —जगत्-कृत्स्न, अम्, n. the whole world, the universe. —जगत्-क्षय, अस्, m. the destruction of the world. —जगत्-त्रय, अम्, n. the three worlds, or heaven, earth, and the lower world (पाताल). —जगत्-पति, इस्, m. ‘lord of the world,’ an epithet of Śiva, also of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa; a king. —जगत्-प्रभु, उस्, m. ‘lord of the world,’ an epithet of Brahmā, of Śiva, of Viṣṇu; an Arhat of the Jainas. —जगत्-प्रसिद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, known throughout the world, notorious. —ज-गत्-प्राण, अस्, m. the breath of the world, wind, air. —जगत्-समग्र, अम्, n. the entire world, the universe. —जगत्-सर्व, अम्, n. the whole world. —जगत्-साक्षिन्, ई, m. the witness or spectator of the world, the sun. —जगत्-सिंह, अस्, m., N. of a son of Māna-siṃha and father of Mahā-siṃha. —ज-गत्-स्रष्ट्टि, टा, m. the creator of the world; Brahmā; Śiva. —जगत्-स्वामिन्, ई, m. lord of the world, the supreme deity; N. of an image of the sun in Dvādaśādityāśrama; N. of Viṣṇu. —जगद्-अन्त, अस्, m. the end of the world. —जगद्-अन्तक, अस्, m. the destroyer of the world. —जगदन्त-कान्तक (°क-अन्°), अस्, m. destroying the destroyer of the world. —जगद्-अम्बा, f. the mother of the world, a N. of Durgā. —जगद्-आत्मक, अस्, आ, अम्, whose self is the world, identical with the world. —जगद्-आत्मन्, आ, m. the soul of the world, the supreme spirit. —जगद्-आदि-ज, अस्, m. the first-born of the world, an epithet of Śiva. —जगद्-आधार, अस्, m. ‘stay or supporter of the universe,’ an epithet of Time; also of the Jina Vīra; air, wind. —जगद्-आनन्द, अस्, आ, अम्, rejoicing the world. —जगद्-आयु, उस्, m. or जगद्-आयुस्, उस्, m. the life-spring of the world, an epithet of the wind. —जगद्-ईश, अस्, m. ‘lord of the universe,’ and epithet of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa, also of Śiva and Brahmā; N. of a man; N. of the author of a commentary entitled Anumāna-dīdhiti-ṭippanī. —जगद्-ईश्वर, अस्, m. the lord of the universe; an epithet of Śiva; a king; N. of the author of the play Hāsyārṇava. —जगद्-उद्धार, अस्, m. the salvation or deliverance of the world. —जगद्-एकनाथ, अस्, m. the sole monarch of the world; an epithet of Raghu. —जगद्-एक-पावन, अस्, ई, अम्, the sole purifier of the world. —जगद्-गुरु, उस्, m. the father of the world; an epithet of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and Rāma (as an incarnation of Viṣṇu). —जगद्-गौरी, f. an epithet of Manasādevī, the deified wife of the sage Jaratkāru and sister of the Nāgas or serpent-race. —जगद्-घातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, destroying the world, destructive, hostile to mankind. —जगद्-दीप, अस्, m. ‘illumi-nator of the world,’ an epithet of the sun. —जगद्-द्वीप, अस्, m. wrong reading for जगद्-वीज, q. v. —जगद्-धर, अस्, m. ‘supporter or sustainer of the world,’ N. of the author of a commentary on the plays Mālatī-mādhava and Veṇī-saṃhāra, a son of Ratna-dhara and grandson of Vidyā-dhara. —ज-गद्-धातृ, ता, m. ‘maintainer of the world,’ an epithet of Brahmā and of Viṣṇu; (त्री), f. ‘fosterer of the world,’ an epithet of Sarasvatī and Durgā. —जगद्-बल, अस्, m. ‘the strength of the world,’ or ‘surrounding the world,’ (fr. rt. वल्), wind, air. —जगद्-योनि, इस्, m. ‘the womb or place of pro-duction of the world,’ an epithet of Śiva, Viṣṇu, Kṛṣṇa, and Brahmā; (इस्), f. the mother of all living beings, the earth. —जगद्-वन्द्य, अस्, m. ‘to be praised or adored by the world,’ an epithet of Kṛṣṇa. —जगद्-वहा, f. ‘bearer of all living beings,’ the earth. —जगद्-विनाश, अस्, m. the de-struction of the world, the expiration of a Yuga or period of the world's existence. —जगद्-वीज, अम्, n. seed or first principle of the world, epithet of Śiva. —जगन्-नाथ, अस्, m. ‘the lord of the world,’ a N. of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa; also of Rāma and of Dattātreya (both incarnations of Viṣṇu); N. of a celebrated idol; also of a temple, and the surrounding district on the Coromandel coast near Cuttack in Orissa, where Viṣṇu is especially worshipped as Jagan-nāth; (pilgrimages are made from all parts of India to the idol of Jagannāth there enshrined; see जगन्नाथ-क्षेत्र and पुरुषोत्तम-क्षेत्र); N. of the author of a work entitled Rekhā-gaṇita; the author of the poem Bhāminī-vilāsa; N. of a son of Rudra who compiled at the end of the last century the work Vivāda-bhaṅgārṇava; (औ), m. du. epithet of Viṣṇu and Śiva; (आ), f. epithet of Durgā. —जगन्नाथ-क्षेत्र, अम्, n. the shrine of Jagannātha and sur-rounding district, see above. —जगन्नाथ-वल्ल-भ-नाटक, अम्, n. title of a play. —जगन्-निवास, अस्, m. the abode of the world, an epithet of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa; worldly existence. —जगन्-मणि, इस्, m., N. of a copyist. —जगन्-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, con-taining the whole world. —जगन्-मातृ, ता, f. ‘mother of the world,’ epithet of Durgā and Lakṣmī.
जगन्वस्: जगन्वस्, वान्, ग्मुषी, वत् (perf. part.), one who has gone.
जग्मि: जग्मि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. going, being in constant motion; going to, hastening towards (with acc. or loc.); (इस्), m. the wind, air.
जग्मि जग्मि, जग्मिवस्। See under जगत्।
जग्मिवस्: जग्मिवस्, वान्, मुषी, वत्, who or what has gone.
जङ्गम: जङ्गम, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. Intens. of rt. गम्), moving, movable, locomotive, that which has motion as opposed to that which is stationary, living; a living being (= जगत् in the earlier language); de-rived from living beings; [cf. Goth. gagga; Germ. Gang.] —जङ्गम-कुटी, f. a parasol, a chattar or umbrella (‘movable house’). —जङ्गम-त्व, अम्, n. the state of having motion, movableness.
जगद: जगद जगद, अस्, m. an attendant, a guardian.
जगद्दल: जगद्दल जगद्दल, अस्, m., N. of a king of the Darads.
जगनु: जगनु जगनु or जगन्नु, उस्, m. a living being, an animal; an insect; fire or its deity.
जगर: जगर जगर, अस्, m. armour, mail; [cf. जागर।]
जगल: जगल जगल, अस्, आ, अम्, fraudulent, knav-ish; (अस्), m. a kind of intoxicating beverage, any fluid suitable for distillation; the plant Vangueria Spinosa, = मदन-वृक्ष; armour, mail [cf. ज-गर]; (अम्), n. cow-dung.
जगुरि: जगुरि जगुरि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. rt. गम् or गा), Ved. leading, conducting.
जग्गिक: जग्गिक जग्गिक, अस्, m., N. of a man.
जघन: जघन जघन, अस्, अम्, m. n. in the later language always n. (probably a reduplicated form of rt. हन्, but by some connected with जंह्), the hinder part, the buttock, the hip and loins, the pudenda, mons veneris; rear-guard, reserve of an army; [cf. जङ्घा।] —जघन-कूपक, औ, m. du. the hollow of the loins of a handsome woman. —जघन-गौरव, अम्, n. the weight of the hips. —जघन-चपला, f. a libidinous woman (moving the hips); a woman active in dancing; a species of the Āryā metre. —जघन-तस्, ind. behind, on the hinder part, after; [cf. अग्र-तस्।] —जघनार्ध (°न-अर्°), अस्, m. the hinder part (opposed to पूर्वार्ध); rear-guard, reserve of an army. —जघने-फला, f. the opposite-leaved fig-tree, Ficus Oppositifolia.
जघनिन्: जघनिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having stout hips or large buttocks.
जघनेन: जघनेन, ind. behind, (with gen. or acc.) back-wards, away from.
जघन्य: जघन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, hindmost, hinder, last, latest, lowest, low, worst, vilest, vile, base, shortest, least, least important; of low origin or rank; (अस्), m. a Śūdra or man of the lowest class; N. of the attendant of Mālavya, who was one of the five princes born under particular constellations; (अम्), n. the penis; (अम् or ए), ind. after, behind, last; जघन्ये कृ, to leave behind, turn the back on; [cf. Hib. deaghanach, ‘last.’] —जघन्य-गुण-वृत्ति-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, addicted to low pursuits, chiefly familiar with the lowest of the three Guṇas. —जघन्य-च-पला, f. a species of the Āryā metre; [cf. जघन-चपला।] —जघन्य-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, last born, young-est; low-born; (अस्), m. a younger brother; a Śūdra. —जघन्य-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, lower, inferior. —ज-घन्य-तस्, ind. behind, at the back, after. —जघन्य-शायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, lying down last, going to bed last.
जघन्वस्: जघन्वस् जघन्वस्, वान्, घ्नुषी, वत् (fr. rt. हन्), who or what has killed.
जघ्नि: जघ्नि, इस्, इस्, इ, striking, killing; (इस्), m. a weapon, offensive instrument.
जघ्निवस्: जघ्निवस्, वान्, घ्नुषी, वत् (perf. part.), = जघन्वस् above.
जघ्नु: जघ्नु, उस्, उस्, उ, striking, beating, killing.
जघ्रि: जघ्रि जघ्रि, इस्, इस्, इ (reduplicated form fr. rt. घृ), Ved. pouring out, sprinkling about.
जङ्क्ष्: जङ्क्ष् जङ्क्ष्, cl. 1. P. जङ्क्षति, a various reading for क्षज् or क्षञ्ज्।
जङ्ग: जङ्ग जङ्ग, अस्, m., N. of a man.
जङ्गपूग: जङ्गपूग जङ्गपूग, अस्, m. wickedness, sin (?).

जङ्गाल: जङ्गाल, अस्, m. a land-mark, a limit, a boundary, a ridge of earth running along the edge of a field for collecting water and forming a passage over it, a balk.
जङ्गिड: जङ्गिड जङ्गिड, अस्, m., N. of a plant which is worn as an amulet.
जङ्घ: जङ्घ जङ्घ, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. जन्, or corrupted from जङ्गा fr. rt. गा, to go, or fr. rt. जंह्; cf. जघन), N. of a Rakṣas; (आ), f. the shank or lower part of the leg from the ankle to the knee; (in the earlier language also) the upper part of the leg; a part of a bedstead; [cf. Schenkel.] —जङ्घा-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, or जङ्घा-करिक, अस्, आ, अम्, active with the legs, running quickly, a runner. —जङ्घा-कारिक, अस्, m. a runner, a courier, an express. —जङ्घा-त्राण, अम्, n. armour or protection for the legs, cuisses or greaves. —जङ्घा-बन्धु, उस्, m., N. of a man. —जङ्घा-रथ, अस्, m., N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl. his descendants. —जङ्घारि (°घा-अरि), इस्, m., N. of a man.

जङ्घिका: जङ्घिका, f. a diminutive fr. जङ्घा।
जङ्घिल: जङ्घिल, अस्, आ, अम्, running swiftly, quick, rapid.
जज्: जज् जज्, cl. 1. P. जजति, &c., to fight; [cf. जञ्ज्; cf. also Hib. fighim, ‘I fight;’ Germ. fechte; Old Germ. vihtu; Lat. pugno.]
जज: जज, अस्, m. a warrior. —जजौजस् (°ज-ओज्°), अस्, n. prowess, valour; [cf. जाजिन्।]
जज्ज: जज्ज जज्ज, अस्, m., N. of a man.
जज्जल: जज्जल, अस्, m., N. of a man.
जज्ञि: जज्ञि जज्ञि, इस्, इस्, इ (reduplicated form fr. rt. जन्), germinating, shooting.
जझ्झती: जझ्झती जझ्झती, ईस्, f. pl., Ved. (scil. आपस्), dashing, splashing or rushing waters; (an onomato-poetic word formed like a pres. part. from a supposed rt. जझ्झ्।)
जञ्ज्: जञ्ज् जञ्ज्, cl. 1. P. जञ्जति, &c., = जज्, to fight; [cf. Lith. ẓinczíju.]
जञ्जणाभवत्: जञ्जणाभवत् जञ्जणा-भवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. glittering, flashing.

जट्: जट् जट् (probably a rt. derived fr. जट below), cl. 1. P. जटति, &c., to clot, to form into a concrete mass, to become twisted together or entangled and matted as hair; [cf. झट्।]
जट: जट जट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. जन् ?), wearing twisted or entangled locks of hair; (आ), f. the hair matted and twisted together as worn by the god Śiva and by ascetics and persons in mourning; the long tresses of hair twisted or braided together, and coiled in a knot over the head so as to project like a horn from the forehead, or at other times allowed to fall carelessly over the back and shoulders; a fibrous root, a root in general; N. of several plants, = जटा-मांसी; Mucuna Pruritus, Flacourtia Cata-phracta; Asparagus Racemosus; also = रुद्र-जटा [cf. कृष्ण-जटा]; N. of a Pāṭha or arrangement of the Vedic text so called from a peculiar repetition and inversion of the words, (it is a still more artificial arrangement than the Krama-pāṭha, each pair of words being repeated three times and one repetition being in inverted order.) —जटा-कर, अस्, आ, अम्, matting the hair. —जटा-चीर or जटाटीर, अस्, m. a N. of Śiva. —जटा-जूट, अस्, m. the long tresses of hair twisted on the top of the head; a quantity of twisted hair; Śiva's hair. —जटा-ज्वाल, अस्, m. ‘having a flame like a tuft,’ a lamp. —जटा-टङ्क, अस्, m. an epithet of Śiva; [cf. कटङ्कट।] —जटा-धर, अस्, आ, अम्, wearing twisted or matted hair; (अस्), m. any mendicant or ascetic wearing the Jaṭā; an epithet of Śiva; N. of one of the attendants of Skanda; N. of a Buddha; N. of a lexicographer; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people in the south of India. —जटा-धारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, wearing matted or braided hair. —जटा-पाठ, अस्, m. the Jaṭā reading or arrangement of the Vedic text, see above. —जटा-बन्ध, अस्, m. the knot or coil of matted hair. —जटा-मण्डल, अम्, n. braided or twisted hair forming a coil on the top of the head. —जटा-मांसी, f. the plant Nardostachys Jaṭāmāṃsi. —जटा-मालिन्, ई, m., N. of a form of Śiva, ‘garlanded with matted hair.’ —जटा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, wearing the Jaṭā, wearing knotted or clotted hair; (ती), f. = जटा-मांसी. —जटा-वल्ली, f., N. of two plants, = रुद्र-जटा and गन्ध-मांसी। —जटासुर (°टा-अस्°), अस्, m., N. of a Rakṣas killed by Bhīma-sena; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people living in the north-east of Madhya-deśa. —जटे-श्वर-तीर्थ (°टा-ईश्°), अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.
जटायु: जटायु, उस्, and जटायुस्, उस्, m., N. of a fabulous bird, the king of the vultures (गृध्र-राज), son of Aruṇa and Śyenī (or according to the Rāmāyaṇa, son of Garuḍa), and younger brother of Sampāti. (It is related in Chap. XX of the Araṇya-kāṇḍa of the Rāmāyaṇa, that whilst Rāma was on his way to Pañcavatī he met Jaṭāyus, who declared his intention of aiding Rāma, out of regard for his father Daśa-ratha. Accordingly when Rāvaṇa carried off Sītā, the semi-divine bird attempted to rescue her, but was defeated and mortally wounded by Rāvaṇa; Chap. LVI); bdellium, see गुग्गुलु; N. of a mountain.
जटाल: जटाल, अस्, आ, अम्, wearing a coil of twisted or clotted hair; (अस्), m. bdellium; a kind of Curcuma (कर्चूर); the plant Bignonia Suaveolens; the Indian fig-tree or वट; (आ), f. = जटा-मांसी।
जटालक: जटालक, अस्, इका, अम्, wearing knotted or matted hair.
जटि: जटि, इस्, f. clotted or twisted hair, an assemblage, multitude; the waved-leaf fig-tree, Ficus Venosa (= प्लक्ष); [cf. जटी and धुर्जटि।]
जटिक: जटिक, अस्, आ, अम्, wearing twisted or braided hair (= जटिन् ?).
जटिन्: जटिन्, ई, इनी, इ, wearing the Jaṭā, having twisted hair; (ई), m. an epithet of Śiva; N. of one of the attendants of Skanda; an elephant sixty years old; waved-leaf fig-tree (= प्लक्ष).
जटिल: जटिल, अस्, आ, अम्, wearing the Jaṭā, having clotted or entangled hair; complicated, twisted together, intermixed, confused; (अस्), m. a lion; a goat with certain marks; N. of a man; (आ), f., N. of a woman with the patronymic Gautamī said to have had seven husbands, mother-in-law of Rādhikā; N. of several plants, = जटा-मांसी; long pepper; also = उच्चटा; = वचा, Acorus Calamus; = दमनक. —जटिल-स्थल, अम्, n., N. of a place.
जटिलक: जटिलक, अस्, m., N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl. the descendants of this man; (इका), f., N. of a woman.
जटिलीकृ: जटिली-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-तुम्, to twist together, form into a clotted mass, to braid; to complicate, interweave, wrap round.
जटिलीभाव: जटिली-भाव, अस्, m. the being twisted together, complication, confusion.
जटी: जटी, f. the waved-leaf fig-tree [cf. जटि]; also = जटा-मांसी।
जटुल: जटुल जटुल, अस्, m. a freckle, a mark; [cf. जडुल।]
जठर: जठर जठर, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. rt. जन्), hard, firm; old; bound, tied (?); yellowish (?); (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people in the south-east of Madhya-deśa; (अस्), m., N. of a mountain; (अस्, अम्), m. n. the stomach, belly, abdomen, viscera, bowels; the womb; a hole, cavity; the interior of anything; the bosom; certain morbid affections of the bowels; Ved. course (?); [cf. Goth. qvithrs, Them. qvithra; Lat. venter ?]. —जठर-गद, अस्, m. a morbid affection of the abdomen or bowels, dropsy (?). —जठर-ज्वाला, f. belly-ache, colic, en-teritis. —जठर-नुद्, त्, m. the plant Cathartocar-pus Fistula; [cf. आरग्बध।] —जठर-यन्त्रणा or जठर-यातना, f. pain endured by the child in the womb before birth. —जठर-रोग, अस्, m. = जठर-गद above. —जठर-व्यथा, f. stomach-ache, colic. —जठर-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, or जठर-स्थायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, or जठर-स्थित, अस्, आ, अम्, being in the belly, being in the womb. —जठराग्नि (°र-अग्°), इस्, m. the digestive fire of the stomach, the gastric juice [cf. अग्नि and जाठर]; a N. of Agastya in a former birth; [cf. दह्राग्नि।] —जठरामय (°र-आम्°), अस्, m. dropsy, water in the abdomen.
जठरिन्: जठरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, having a large belly; abdo-minal, = उदरिन्, q. v.
जठरीकृत: जठरी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, contained in the belly; concealed in the bosom.
जठल: जठल, अस्, अम्, m. n. (?), Ved. = जठर; (Sāy.) the cavity or receptacle of waters, the ocean.
जड: जड जड, अस्, आ, अम् (perhaps corrupted fr. rt. जल्, cf. जल), cold, frigid, chilly; stiff; stunned, para-lyzed, motionless, apathetic, senseless, stupid, idiotic, irrational, dumb; stunning, stupefying; (अस्), m. ‘the stupid one,’ an epithet of Su-mati who, though intelli-gent, simulated stupidity; cold, frost, winter; idiocy, fatuity, stupidity; dulness, apathy, sluggishness of mind or body; (आ), f. the plant Mucuna Pruritus; also the plant Flacourtia Cataphracta [cf. जटा]; (अम्), n. water [cf. जल]; lead; [cf. Hib. fiod, fuar.] —जड-क्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, working slowly or stupidly, dilatory. —जड-ता, f. or जड-त्व, अम्, n. coldness, chilliness, frigidness, apathy, stupidity, stupe-faction, despair. —जड-धी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, stupid, idiotic. —जड-भरत, अस्, m. ‘the stupid Bharata,’ N. of a man simulating stupidity; an idiot in general.
जडिमन्: जडिमन्, आ, m. frigidity, stupefaction, insensibility, stupidity, dulness.
जडीकृ: जडी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to stun, stupify, benumb, congeal. —जडी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, stunned, rendered cold or torpid or insensible, stupe-fied, confounded, paralyzed.
जडीभू: जडी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -वितुम्, to become insensible or stupid or frozen or rigid. —जडी-भाव, अस्, m. frigidity, coldness, apathy, stupidity. —जडी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become torpid, stunned, stupefied, paralyzed, infatuated.
जडुल: जडुल जडुल, अस्, m. a freckle, a mark; [cf. जटुल and जतु-मणि।]
जतु: जतु जतु, उ, n. (said to be fr. rt. जन्), lac, a red dye or pigment formed by an insect analogous to cochineal, a kind of gum; (ऊ, ऊस्), f. a bat. —जतु-कारी, f. or जतु-कृत्, त्, f. a kind of fragrant tree, = जतुका, (‘making lac,’ the lac insect forming its nest in this tree.) —जतु-कृष्णा, f. = पर्पटी। —जतु-गृह, अम्, n. a house plastered with lac, resin, and other combustible substances, (such a house was built for the reception of the Pāṇḍava princes in Vāraṇāvata by Purocana, at the instigation of Dur-yodhana, the object being to burn them alive when they were asleep after a festival. Warned, however, by Vidura, they discovered the dangerous character of their abode, and dug an underground passage by which to escape from the interior. Next having invited an outcaste woman with her five sons to a feast, they first stupefied them with wine, and then having burnt Purocana in his own house, set fire to the house of lac and, leaving the charred bodies of the woman and her sons inside, escaped by the under-ground passage; see Mahā-bh. I. 5864.) —जतु-गेह, अम्, n. = जतु-गृह. —जतु-पुत्रक, अस्, m. a man at chess or backgammon &c. (coloured with lac). —जतु-मणि, इस्, m. a mole, a natural mark on the body. —जतु-मुख, अस्, m. a kind of rice. —जतु-रस, अस्, m. lac, the dye. —जतु-वेश्मदाह, अस्, m. the conflagration of the house of lac. —जतु-वेश्मन्, अ, n. = जतु-गृह, q. v. —जतू-कर्ण, अस्, m., N. of a man; (a various reading for जातूकर्ण।) —जत्व्-अश्मक, अम्, n. red arsenic; [cf. शिला-जतु।]
जतुक: जतुक, अम्, n. lac, see जतु; Asa Fœtida [cf. जातुक]; (आ), f. lac; a kind of fragrant plant or tree, = जतु-कृत्, जतूका, जनी, &c.; also = पर्पटी; a bat; [cf. जतुनी, जतूका, अश्म-जतुक।]
जतूका: जतूका, f. a kind of fragrant plant; a bat.
जत्रु: जत्रु जत्रु, उस्, उ, m. n. (said to be fr. rt. जन्; in the earlier language m. and pl. only), the continuations of the vertebræ; (in later Sanskrit) the collar-bone, clavicle; ऊर्ध्व-जत्रु, the part of the body above the collar-bone.
जत्रुक: जत्रुक, अम्, n. the collar-bone, the clavicle.
जन्: जन् जन्, cl. 1. 3. P. जनति, जजन्ति, जजान, जनिष्यति, जनितुम्, to generate, beget, (in these senses Ved.); cl. 4. A. जायते, जज्ञे, जनिष्-यते, अजनिष्ट and अजनि, जनितुम् (Ved. जनितोस्), to be born or produced, to come into existence; to grow (as plants &c.); to be born again; to be, be-come, take place, happen; to be possible, applicable, suitable, &c.; to be born for or destined for anything (with acc., e. g. तं लोकं जायते, he is born for that world, Ved.): Caus. जनयति, -ते, अजीजनत्, जन-यितुम् (Ved. जनयितवै), to generate, beget, bring forth, produce, create, cause, occasion; to cause to be born; to assign, procure: Desid. जिजनि-षति: Intens. जञ्जन्यते and जाजायते, जञ्जन्ति, जाजाति; [cf. Gr. γίγνομαι; Lat. gigno, genui, (g)nascor; Hib. genim, ‘I beget, generate;’ Lith. gemù; Goth. kin in keina, kain; Germ. Kind, &c.]
जन: जन, अस्, m. a created being, a creature, a living being, man; a person or individual in general, (used collectively in sing. as well as in pl., e. g. दैव्यो जनः or दिव्यो जनः, the gods collectively; often at the end of a compound, e. g. प्रेष्य-जन, a servant; स्वजन-जन, a relation; दास-जन, a slave; सखी-जन, a female friend); people, race, tribe, subjects, nation (e. g. पञ्च जनाः, the five races of men or nations; cf. चर्षणि and कृष्टि); the person nearest to the speaker (hence अयं जनः = this person, these persons, often = I, I myself, we our-selves; cf. hic homo); a common person, one of the people; the world beyond the Mahar-loka, the heaven of deified mortals or the people living in it [cf. जन-लोक]; N. of a man with the patronymic Śārkarā-kṣya; (आ), f. birth, production; [cf. अन्तःपुर-जन, इतर-जन, कुल-जन, गुरु-जन, तिरो-जन, &c.; cf. also Hib. duine, man either male or female; Goth. qvinô; Slav. schena.] —जनं-सह, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. subduing all creatures, epithet of Indra. —जन-कल्प, अस्, आ, अम्, containing cere-monial ordinances for mankind, (जनकल्पा ऋचः, applied to several verses of the Atharva-veda); similar to mankind. —जनङ्-गम, अस्, m. a Cāṇḍāla, a man of a low or degraded tribe; [cf. जलङ्-गम।] —जन-चक्षुस्, उस्, n. the eye of all creatures, the sun; [cf. जगच्-चक्षुस्।] —जन-ता, f. a number of men, an assemblage of people, a community; people, subjects; mankind, manhood; birth, generation. —जन-त्रय, अम्, n. three per-sons. —जन-त्रा, f. (for जल-त्रा ?), an umbrella, a parasol. —जन-देव, अस्, m. a king. —जनन्-तप, अस्, m., N. of a man. —जन-पद, अस्, m. a community, nation, people (sing. or pl.); the people (as opposed to the sovereign); an empire, an inhabited country; man, mankind; [cf. जान-पद।] —जनपदाधिप (°द-अध्°), अस्, m. the ruler of a people or empire, a prince, a king. —ज-नपदायुत (°द-आय्°), अस्, आ, अम्, crowded with people, populous. —जनपदिन्, ई, m. the ruler of an empire, a prince, king. —जनपदेश्वर (°द-ईश्°), अस्, m. the lord of a country. —जन-प्रवाद, अस्, m. ‘the talk of men,’ rumour, report. —जन-प्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्, fond of mankind; philanthropic; (अस्), m. an epithet of Śiva; coriander-seed; the tree Morunga Hyperanthera, = शोभाञ्जन. —जन-भक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. devouring men; (Sāy.) loving men or to be loved by men. —जन-भृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. supporting men. —जन-मरक, अस्, m. ‘men-killer,’ an epidemic disease. —जन-मर्यादा, f. popular observance, established usage. —जनम्-एजय, अस्, m. ‘causing men to tremble,’ N. of a celebrated king to whom Vaiśampāyana recited the Mahā-bhārata, (he was great-grandson to Arjuna, as being son and successor to Parikṣit, who was son of Abhi-manyu, who was son of Arjuna); N. of a son of Kuru; of a son of Puru; of Purañ-jaya; of Soma-datta; of Su-mati; N. of a Nāga. —जन-मोहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, infatuating men. —जन-योपन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. impeding or perplexing men, causing them to suffer; (Sāy.) gladdening men. —जन-रञ्जन, अम्, n. gratifying the people, courting popular favour. —जन-रव, अस्, m. rumour, report; calumny, scandal. —जन-राज्, ट्, or जन-राजन्, आ, m., Ved. king of men, ruler of men. —जन-लोक, अस्, m. one of the seven Lokas or divisions of the universe, the fifth or next above Mahar-loka, where the sons of Brahmā and other pious men reside; [cf. जनस्।] —जन-वल्लभ, अस्, आ, अम्, agreeable to men; a favourite with men, fond of men; (अस्), m., N. of a plant, = श्वेत-रोहित. —जन-वाद, अस्, m. ‘the talk of men,’ news, rumour, report, scandal; [cf. जने-वाद and जनो-वाद।] —जन-वादिन्, ई, m., Ved. a talker, newsmonger, gossip, tattler. —जन-विद्, त्, त्, त्, pos-sessing men. —जन-व्यवहार, अस्, m. popular practice or usage. —जन-श्री, ईस्, ईस्, इ, Ved. coming or going to men; epithet of Pūṣan. —जन-श्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, known among men; (अस्), m., N. of a man; (आ), f., N. of a woman. —जन-श्रुति, इस्, f. rumour, news, tidings, intelligence. —जन-सं-सद्, त्, f. an assembly of men. —जन-सङ्क्षय, अस्, m. destruction of men. —जन-सम्बाध, अस्, आ, अम्, densely crowded with people (a place). —जन-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, living or abiding among men. —जन-स्थान, अम्, n. ‘the resort of demons,’ N. of a part of the Daṇḍaka forest in the Dakhin. —जनस्थान-रुह, अस्, आ, अम्, growing in Jana-sthāna. —जनाकीर्ण (°न-आक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, crowded with people. —जनाचार (°न-आच्°), अस्, m. popular usage or custom, propriety, decorum, good conduct. —जनातिग (°न-अत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, superhuman, superior. —जनाधिनाथ (°न-अध्°), अस्, m. su-preme lord of men, a king; an epithet of Viṣṇu. —जनाधिप (°न-अध्°), अस्, m. a ruler of men, a prince, a king. —जनान्त (°न-अन्°), अस्, m. a place removed from men, an uninhabited place; a region; personal proximity; an epithet of Yama, the destroyer of men. —जनान्तिक (°न-अन्°), अम्, n. secret communication, whispering, speaking aside to another; (अम्), ind. (as a stage-direction) speak-ing aside, aside. —जनायन (°न-अय्°), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. leading to men. —जनार्णव (°न-अर्°), अस्, m. ‘ocean of men,’ a large concourse of people, a caravan. —जनार्थ-शब्द (°न-अर्°), अस्, m. a family appellation, a gentile noun. —जनार्दन (°न-अर्°), अस्, m. an epithet of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa (exciting or agitating men); N. of several men. —जनार्-दन-विबुध, अस्, m., N. of the author of a com-mentary called Bhāvārtha-dīpikā. —जनाव् (°न-अव्), औस्, m., Ved. a preserver or protector of mankind. —जनाशन (°न-अश्°), अस्, m. ‘man-eater,’ a wolf. —जनाश्रय (°न-आश्°), अस्, m. an asylum or shelter for men, an inn, caravansary. —जना-षह् (in some forms जना-सह्), षाट्, ट्, ट्, Ved. subduing men. —जनेन्द्र (°न-इन्°), अस्, m. the prince or lord of men, a king. —जने-वाद, अस्, m. rumour, report; [cf. जन-वाद।] —जनेश or जनेश्वर (°न-ईश्°), अस्, m. lord of men, a king. —जनेष्ट (°न-इष्°), अस्, आ, अम्, desired or praised by mankind; (अस्), m. a kind of jasmine (मुद्गर); (आ), f., N. of a fra-grant plant, = जतुका; N. of a medicinal plant, = वृद्धि; turmeric, = हरिद्रा; the flower of Jas-minum Grandiflorum, = जाती-पुष्प. —जनोदाह-रण (°न-उद्°), अम्, n. ‘laudation of men,’ glory, fame. —जनौ, cf. जनाव्. —जनौघ (°न-ओघ), अम्, n. a multitude of people, a crowd, a mob.
जनक: जनक, अस्, इका, अम्, generative, generating, be-getting, producing, causing; (अस्), m. a father, a progenitor; N. of two kings of Videha or Mithilā, one a son of Mithi and father of Udāvasu, the other a son of Hrasva-roman and father of Rāma's wife Sītā, who is therefore called जनक-तनया, जनक-नन्दिनी, जनक-सुता, and जनकात्मजा; N. of a disciple of Bhagavat and of several others; (आस्), m. pl. the descendants of Janaka; (इका), f. a daughter-in-law [cf. जनि and जनी]; a mother. —जनक-काण, अस्, m. ‘the one-eyed Janaka,’ N. of a man. —जनक-चन्द्र, अस्, m., N. of several persons. —जनक-ता, f. or जनक-त्व, अम्, n. generative-ness, productiveness, paternity. —जनक-भद्र, अस्, m., N. of a man. —जनक-राज, अस्, m., N. of a man. —जनक-सप्तरात्र, अस्, m., N. of a Saptāha. —जनक-सिंह, अस्, m., N. of a man. —जनकात्मजा (°क-आत्°), f., see above. —जन-केश्वर-तीर्थ (°क-ईश्°), अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.
जनत्: जनत्, ind. a sacred exclamation used in religious ceremonies (like ॐ &c.) without any definite meaning.
जनन: जनन, अस्, ई, अम्, generating, begetting, pro-ducing, causing; (अस्), m. a parent, progenitor, a creator; (ई), f. a mother; a queen-mother; a bat; lac; N. of several plants, = जनी, यूथिका, कटुका, मञ्जिष्ठा; tenderness, compassion; (अम्), n. birth, production, causation, coming into existence, life (e. g. पूर्वे जनने, in a former birth, i. e. in a former life); race, lineage, family; [cf. इन्द्र-ज-नन and मेधा-जनन।]
जननि: जननि, इस्, f. = जननी, a mother; birth; N. of a plant, = जनी।
जननीय: जननीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be produced, produced.
जनयत्: जनयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, begetting, generating, engendering, producing.
जनयति: जनयति, इस्, f., Ved. generation, engendering, production.
जनयन्त: जनयन्त, अस्, आ, अम्, generating, producing.
जनयितव्य: जनयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be engendered, generated, produced.
जनयितृ: जनयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, generating, begetting, producing, who or what produces; (ता), m. a pro-genitor, a father; (त्री), f. a mother.
जनस्: जनस्, अस्, n., Ved. race, class of beings; (Sāy.) generator, parent; (अस्) or जनर्, ind. (before soft letters generally जनर्), N. of one of the seven worlds or divisions of the universe; see जन and जन-लोक। —जनो-लोक, अस्, m. the world described above.
जनि: जनि, इस्, or जनी, f. a woman, wife, mother; any female animal, (in the Veda perhaps metaphorically = the fingers, e. g. जनिभिः समिद्ध, kindled by the fingers); the wife of a son or brother's son; birth, production; birthplace; a kind of fragrant plant; [cf. Hib. gean, ‘a woman;’ Goth. qvêns, qveins; Eng. queen.] —जनि-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. wishing for a wife. —१। जनि-त्व or जनि-त्वन, अम्, n. the state of a wife, wedlock, conjugal state. —जनि-दा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. giving a wife. —जनि-नीलिका, f., N. of a plant, = महा-नीली. —जनि-मत् or जनि-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having a wife, relating to women.
जनि or जनी; add — cf. Gr. γυνή
जनिक: जनिक, अस्, आ, अम्, producing, generating.
जनित: जनित, अस्, आ, अम्, engendered, begotten; pro-duced, occasioned; occurring. —जनित-स्वन, अस्, आ, अम्, making a noise, sounding. —जनितोद्यम (°त-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, making exertion, energetic.
जनितव्य: जनितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be born or produced.
जनितृ: जनितृ, ता, m. a father, progenitor; (त्री), f. a mother; [cf. Lat. genitor; Gr. γενέτωρ, γενετήρ; Hib. genteoir, ‘a begetter, sower, planter;’ Lat. genitrix; Gr. γενέτειρα.]
जनित्र: जनित्र, अम्, n., Ved. a birthplace, place of ori-gin, home; origin, generative or procreative matter; N. of a Sāman; (आणि), n. pl. parents, relatives.
जनित्व: 2. जनित्व, अस्, आ, अम्, = जनितव्य, to be born or produced; (अस्), m. father; (आ), f. mother; (औ), m. du. father and mother, parents.
जनिमन्: जनिमन्, अ, n. (said to be also m.), Ved. birth, generation, engenderment, production; offspring, de-scendants; a creature, being; gender, sex, genus, kind, race; [cf. Hib. geineamhuin, ‘birth, conception.’]
जनिष्ठ: जनिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. a superl. fr. जनितृ (?).
जनिष्य: जनिष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be born or produced.
जनीन: जनीन, अस्, आ, अम्, suitable for men.
जनीय: जनीय, nom. P., Ved. जनीयति or जनियति, to wish for a wife.
जनु: जनु, उस्, and जनू, ऊस्, f. birth; [cf. जनुस्।]
जनुस्: जनुस्, उस्, n. (Ved. Nom. m. जनूस्, Acc. जनु-षम्, Inst. जनुषा), birth, production, descent; nativity; birthplace; a creature, being; creation; genus, class, kind; जनुषा, ind., Ved. by birth, from birth (e. g. जनुषान्ध, blind from birth), by nature, naturally, originally, essentially, necessa-rily, &c.
जन्तु: जन्तु, उस्, m. a creature, a living being, man, person; people, mankind; any animal, (usually beings of the lowest organization, such as worms, insects, &c.); N. of a son of Somaka; [cf. क्षिति-जन्तु, क्षुद्र-ज्°, जल-ज्°।] —जन्तु-कम्बु, उ, n. any animal living in a shell, as a snail; a snail's shell. —जन्तु-घ्न, अस्, ई, अम्, killing worms; N. of several vermifuge plants; (अस्), m. the citron; (ई), f., N. of a plant, = विडङ्ग; (अम्), n. = विडङ्ग; Asa Fœtida. —जन्तु-नाशन, अस्, ई, अम्, destroying worms; (अम्), n. Asa Fœtida. —जन्तु-पादप, अस्, m., N. of a tree, = कोशाम्र. —जन्तु-फल, अस्, m. the glomerous fig-tree, Ficus Glomerata; [cf. उदुम्बर।] —जन्तु-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, containing worms or insects. —जन्तु-मारिन्, ई, m. or (ई), f. ‘destroying worms,’ the citron. —जन्तु-हन्त्री, f., N. of a vermifuge, = विडङ्ग।
जन्तुक: जन्तुक, अस्, m., N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl. his descendants; (आ), f. lac, gum; a kind of Asa Fœtida; [cf. जतुका।]
जन्तुला: जन्तुला, f. the plant Saccharum Spontaneum.
जन्त्व: जन्त्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be born or produced.
जन्मन्: जन्मन्, अ, n. birth, production, origin, (in comp.) born from (e. g. शूद्र-जन्मन्, born from a Śūdra); existence, life (e. g. दृष्टादृष्ट-जन्मन्, pre-sent and future life); nativity; birthplace, home; a progenitor, father; natal star; (in astrology) N. of the first mansion or Nakṣatra; a creature, being; people; the people of a household, kind, race (e. g. उभे जन्मनी or उभयं जन्म, both races or both kinds of living beings, i. e. gods and men or men and animals); nature, quality, custom, manner (e. g. प्रत्नेन जन्मना, according to ancient custom); = उदक, water (?); [cf. जनिमन्, अग्र-जन्मन्, अन्त्य-ज्°, कश्मीर-ज्°, काश्मीर-ज्°, द्वि-ज्°, &c.; cf. also Lat. ger-men; Hib. geanamhuin, ‘engendering.’] —जन्म-काल, अस्, m. time or hour of birth. —जन्म-कील, अस्, m. ‘pillar or stay of birth,’ an epithet of Viṣṇu. —जन्म-कृत्, त्, m. a progenitor, a father. —जन्म-क्षेत्र, अम्, n. birthplace. —जन्म-चिन्तामणि, इस्, m. title of a work on nativities. —जन्म-ज्येष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, the eldest by birth, the first-born. —जन्म-तिथि, इस्, m. the lunar day on which a birth occurs, birthday. —जन्-म-द, अस्, m. ‘a birth-giver,’ a father, progenitor. —जन्म-दिन, अम्, n. or जन्म-दिवस, अस्, m. a birthday. —जन्म-नक्षत्र, अम्, n. the natal star, the constellation under which a person is born; [cf. जन्म-राशि and जन्मर्क्ष।] —जन्म-ना-मन्, अ, n. the name received at birth (i. e. on the twelfth day after). —जन्म-प, अस्, m. the regent of a planet under which a person is born. —जन्म-पत्त्र, अम्, n. or जन्म-पत्त्रिका, f. a horoscope, the paper or scroll on which are recorded the year, lunar day, configuration, and relative position of the planets &c., of the birth of a particular individual, a table of his fortunes throughout life. —जन्म-पा-दप, अस्, m. the tree under which a person is born, a family-tree. —जन्म-प्रतिष्ठा, f. birthplace; a mother. —जन्म-प्रदीप, अस्, m., N. of a work by Vi-budha. —जन्म-प्रभृति, ind. ever since birth. —जन्म-भाज्, क्, m. a creature, a living being (possessing birth). —जन्म-भाषा, f. mother-tongue. —जन्म-भूमि, इस्, f. birthplace, native country. —जन्म-भृत्, त्, त्, त्, possessing birth, enjoying life. —जन्म-योग, अस्, m. a horoscope. —जन्म-राशि, इस्, m. or जन्म-लग्न, अम्, n. the sign of the zodiac under which a person is born. —जन्म-रोगिन्, ई, इणी, इ, sickly from birth. —जन्मर्क्ष (°म-ऋक्°), अम्, n. the constellation under which a person is born; N. of the first Nakṣatra. —जन्म-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing birth, born, mortal, living. —जन्म-वर्त्मन्, अ, n. ‘the path of birth,’ the vulva. —जन्म-वसुधा, f. native country, home. —जन्म-वैलक्षण्य, अम्, n. acting in a manner contrary to or unbecoming one's birth. —जन्म-शय्या, f. the bed on which a person is born. —जन्-म-शोधन, अम्, n. discharging the obligations derived from birth. —जन्म-साफल्य, अम्, n. at-tainment of the object or end of existence. —जन्म-स्थान, अम्, n. birthplace, native land, home; the womb. —जन्माधिप (°म-अध्°), अस्, m. lord of birth, an epithet of Śiva; the regent of a constellation under which a person is born; [cf. जन्म-प।] —जन्मान्तर (°म-अन्°), अम्, n. another birth, another life; the preceding life; the future life; regeneration; the other world. —जन्मान्तर-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, committed in another birth. —जन्मान्-तरीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to or done in another life. —जन्मान्ध (°म-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, blind from birth, born blind. —जन्माष्टमी (°म-अष्°), f. the birthday of Kṛṣṇa, the eighth day in the dark half of the month Śrāvaṇa or Bhādra, on which Kṛṣṇa was born. —जन्मास्पद (°म-आस्°), अम्, n. birthplace; [cf. भवास्पद।] —जन्मेश (°म-ईश), अस्, m. the regent of a constellation under which any one is born; [cf. जन्म-प।]
जन्मिन्: जन्मिन्, ई, m. a creature, a living being, a man, an animal.
जन्य: जन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be born or produced, pro-ducible; born, produced; (often at the end of a comp.) born from, arising or produced from, occa-sioned by; generating; (अस्), m. a father; (अम्), n. the body; a portent occurring at birth; (अस्, आ, अम्), belonging to a race or family; national; belonging to the same country; vulgar, common, belonging to or relating to men or to the people, fit for men; (अस्), m. the friend or attendant or companion of a bridegroom; a common man; (आ), f. the friend of a mother; the relation or companion of a bride, a bridesmaid; pleasure, happiness; affection; (अम्), n. people; a community, nation; fighting, war, combat; a market, a fair; rumour, report; censure, abuse. —जन्य-ता, f. the state of anything that is to be born or produced.
जन्यु: जन्यु, उस्, m. birth; a creature, an animal, a living and sentient being; fire; an epithet of Brahmā; N. of one of the seven sages of the fourth Manvantara.
जात: जात, अस्, आ, अम्, born &c. See p. 344.

जात जात, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. जन्), born, brought into existence, brought forth, engendered (e. g. मास-जात, born a month ago, one month old; पुत्रो-जातः, a son only by birth, not by quali-ties); grown, produced, arisen, caused, occasioned, appearing, appeared, apparent, manifest; happened; become, present; ready at hand, collected, stored up, possessed, felt, experienced, inspired, with, affected by, (often at the beginning of an adjective compound, see examples below; also at the end of a comp., e. g. पुत्र-जात, having a son born; श्मश्रु-जात, having a beard; दन्त-जात, having teeth just growing); (अस्), m. male issue, a son; a living being (used of men and gods, but especially of the former); (आस्), m. pl., N. of a race of the Haihayas; (आ), f. female offspring, a daughter; जाते, O daughter! (अम्), n. a living being, a creature; birth, production, origin; race, kind, sort, class, species; a multitude or collec-tion of things forming a class (e. g. कर्म-जातम्, the whole aggregate of actions; सुख-जातम्, everything included under the name pleasure); in-dividuality, specific condition; [cf. Gr. γετος; Germ. Kind; Lith. gentis.] —जात-कर्मन्, अ, n. a ceremony at the birth of a child when the navel string is divided, (it consists in touching the infant's tongue thrice with ghee after appropriate prayers); delivery of a new-born infant. —जात-कलाप, अस्, आ, अम्, having a tail (as a peacock). —जात-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen in love. —जात-कोप or जात-क्रो-ध, अस्, आ, अम्, enraged. —जात-कौतुक, अस्, आ, अम्, delighted. —जात-कौतूहल, अस्, आ, अम्, being eagerly desirous. —जात-क्षोभ, अस्, आ, अम्, agitated. —जात-दन्त, अस्, ई, अम्, (a child) that has a tooth or teeth growing; having teeth. —जात-पक्ष, अस्, आ, अम्, whose wings have grown, possessing wings. —जात-पाश, अस्, आ, अम्, having fetters, fettered. —जात-पुत्रा, f. a woman who has borne a son or sons. —जात-प्रत्यय, अस्, आ, अम्, inspired with confidence, confiding, believing. —जात-बल, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing strength, strong. —जात-भी, ईस्, f. ‘fearful,’ N. of a woman. —जात-मन्मथ, अस्, आ, अम्, being in love, fallen in love, loving. —जात-मात्र, अस्, आ, अम्, just born, merely born; (अम्), n. as soon as born, the instant of birth. —जात-रजस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, having the catamenia. —जात-रस, अस्, आ, अम्, having taste or flavour. —जात-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, embodied, having assumed a shape or form, beautiful, brilliant, golden (?); (अम्), n. the form in which a person is born, nakedness; gold; the thorn-apple. —जातरूप-धर, अस्, आ, अम्, quite naked. —जा-तरूप-परिष्कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, adorned with gold. —जातरूप-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, golden. —जातरूप-शिल, अस्, m., N. of a golden mountain. —जात-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, containing the word जात or any other form derived from जन्. —जात-वास-गृह, अम्, n. the room in which a child is born, the room of a lying-in woman. —जात-विद्या, f., Ved. a know-ledge of what exists or of the origin and nature of all things. —जात-विभ्रम, अस्, आ, अम्, flurried, precipitate. —जात-विश्वास, अस्, आ, अम्, having the confidence excited. —जात-वेदस्, आस्, m., Ved. an epithet of Agni; (the meaning is explained in five ways: 1. ‘knowing all created beings;’ 2. ‘possess-ing all creatures or everything existent;’ 3. ‘known by created beings;’ 4. ‘possessing वेदस् = riches;’ 5. ‘possessing वेदस् = wisdom:’ other derivations and explanations are found in the Brāhmaṇas, but the exact sense of this word seems to have been very early lost, and of the five explanations given above only the first two would seem to be admissible for the Vedic texts; (अम्), n. a cheer of victory; [cf. जयाशिस्।] —जय-मति, इस्, m., N. of a Bodhi-sattva. —जय-मती, f., N. of several women; [cf. जय-वत्।] —जय-माधव, अस्, m., N. of a poet. —जय-यज्ञ, अस्, m. the Aśva-medha or sacrifice of a horse as a mark of dominion. —ज-य-राज, अस्, m., N. of several men. —जय-रात, अस्, m., N. of a warrior who took the side of the Kuru princes. —जय-राम, अस्, m., N. of the author of the Nyāya-siddhānta-mālā; a column erected to commemorate a victory. —जय-स्वामिन्, ई, m. the lord of victory; an epithet of Śiva; N. of a scholiast on the Chandoga-sūtras and of the author of a commentary on the Āśvalāyana-Brāhmaṇa. —जयस्वामि-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town founded by Jushka. —जया-कर (°य-आक्°), अस्, m. ‘a mine of victory,’ N. of a man. —जयादित्य (°य-आद्°), अस्, m., N. of a king; N. of the author of the Kāśikā-vṛtti. —जया-देवी, f., N. of a Buddhist deity [cf. जया]; N. of a woman. —जयानन्द (°य-आन्°), अस्, m., N. of a man. —जयानन्द-वार, अस्, m., N. of a man. —जया-नीक (°य-आन्°), अस्, m., N. of a warrior on the side of the Pāṇḍavas. —जयान्तराय (°य-अन्°), अस्, m. an impediment or hindrance to victory. —जयापीड (°य-आप्°), अस्, m., N. of a king of Kaśmīra. —जया-भट्टारिका, f., N. of a place. —जयारव (°य-आर्°), अस्, m. song of victory; [cf. जय-शब्द।] —जयावघोष (°य-अव्°), अस्, m. proclamation of victory, cheering. —जया-वती, f., N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda; [cf. जय-मती and जय-वत्।] —जयावह (°य-आव्°), अस्, आ, अम्, con-ferring victory, victorious; (आ), f. a kind of Croton; [cf. भद्र-दन्तिका।] —जयाशिस् (°य-आश्°), ईस्, f. a prayer for victory; congratulations after a victory; cheer of victory. —जयाश्रय (°य-आश्°), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘the asylum of victory,’ favoured by victory; (आ), f. a kind of grass; [cf. जरडी।] —जयाश्व (°य-अश्°), अस्, m., N. of a hero on the side of the Pāṇḍavas. —जया-सिंह, अस्, m., N. of a man. —जयाह्वा (°य-आह्°), f. = जयावहा, q. v. —जयेन्द्र (°य-इन्°), अस्, m., N. of a king of Kaśmīra; also of another person; a vihāra built by the latter is called Ja-yendra-vihāra. —जयेश्वर (°य-ईश्°), अस्, m., N. of a sanctuary built by Jayā-devī. —जयोद्धुर (°य-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, exulting in victory. —जयोल्-लास-निधि (°य-उल्°), इस्, m. title of a work.
जय, अस्, आ, अम्, conquering; (अस्), m. conquest, see s. v. at p. 339.
जयक: जयक, अस्, आ, अम्, victorious; (अस्), m., N. of a man.
जयत्: जयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, conquering, defeating; ex-celling. —जयत्-सेन, अस्, m., N. of a king of Magadha; of a son of Sārvabhauma; of Nadīna; a N. assumed by the fourth (?) son of Pāṇḍu; (आ), f., N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda; [cf. जय-सेन।] —जयद्-बल, अस्, m. a N. assumed by one of the youngest Pāṇḍu princes at the court of king Virāṭa. —जयद्-रथ, अस्, m., N. of a king of the Sindhus and Sauvīras fighting on the side of the Kuru princes; a son of Vṛhan-manas; a son of Vṛhat-karman; of Vṛhat-kāya; of the tenth Manu.
जयन: जयन, अम्, n. conquering, subduing; armour for cavalry, elephants, &c.; (ई), f., N. of a daughter of Indra; [cf. जयन्ती।] —जयन-युज्, क्, क्, क्, caparisoned (as a war horse), victorious.
जयन्त: जयन्त, अस्, m., N. of a son of Indra; an epithet of Śiva; N. of a Rudra; N. of a son of Dharma by Marutvatī (he was a part of Vāsudeva and = उपेन्द्र); a class of deities (with Jainas) forming a subdivision of the Anuttaras; the moon; the assumed N. of Bhīma at the court of king Virāṭa; N. of a minister of Daśa-ratha; also of a Gandharva, the father of Vikra-māditya; of a king of Gauḍa; of a Brāhman of Kaśmīra; of an author of a grammatical work; N. of a mountain; (ई), f. a flag, a banner; the plant Sesbania Ægyptiaca, = जीवन्ती; blades of barley planted at the commencement of the Daśaharā and gathered at its close; a particular combination in astronomy, or the rising of the asterism Rohiṇī at midnight, on the eighth of the dark half of Srāvaṇa, or in fact on the birthday of Kṛṣṇa, which is then particularly sacred; an epithet of Durgā; of Dāk-ṣāyaṇī (the wife of Śiva) in Hastinā-pura; N. of the tutelary deity of Vasūdreka; N. of the daughter of Indra; N. of the wife of Ṛṣabha received by him from Indra; N. of a river; N. of a country. —ज-यन्त-पत्त्र, अम्, n. ‘leaf of victory or triumph;’ (in law) the sealed and written award of the judge in favour of either party; (in historical tradition) the label on the forehead of a horse turned loose for the Aśva-medha sacrifice. —जयन्त-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town. —जयन्त-स्वामिन्, ई, m., N. of the author of a small treatise on the Vedic accent. —ज-यन्ती-पुरी, f., N. of a town.
जयितृ: जयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a victor, conqueror, victorious.
जयिन्: जयिन्, ई, इनी, इ, conquering, victorious, a con-queror; gaining the victory, winning in a suit at law; granting victory.
जयिष्णु: जयिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, habitually victorious, victorious.
जयुस्: जयुस्, उस्, उस्, उस्, Ved. victorious.
जय्य: जय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be conquered or gained, conquerable, vulnerable.
जर: जर जर, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. जॄ), becoming old or worn out, old; wearing out; causing old age, producing decay, consuming; (अस्), m. wearing out, wasting; (आ), f. the becoming old, old age; old age personified as a daughter of Death; decrepitude, the general debility consequent upon old age; digestion; a kind of date tree, = क्षीरिका; N. of a Rākṣasī worshipped for having united the two halves into which Jarā-sandha (q. v.) was divided at his birth; [cf. वि-जर।] —जरातुर (°रा-आत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, in-firm, decrepit, debilitated, old. —जरा-परिणत, अस्, आ, अम्, stooping, bent down with age or infirmity. —जरा-पुष्ट, अस्, m. = जरा-सन्ध. —जरा-भीरु, उस्, m. love or the deity Kāma (‘afraid of old age’). —जरा-मृत्यु, ऊ, m. du. old age and death; (उस्, उस्, उ), one who dies from old age. —जरा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, aged, old. —जरावस्था (°रा-अव्°), f. state of old age, decrepitude. —जरा-सन्ध, अस्, m., N. of a celebrated king and warrior, sovereign of Magadha and Cedi, son of Bṛhad-ratha, father-in-law to Kaṃśa, and enemy of Kṛṣṇa; he was slain in single combat by Bhīma; (according to a legend, he was born divided in two halves, which were put together by the Rākṣasī Jarā, q. v.; he is also identified with the Dānava Vipracitti, and men-tioned among the hundred sons of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.) —जरासन्ध-जित्, त्, m. ‘conqueror of Jarā-sandha,’ N. of Bhīma-sena, the second of the Pāṇḍu princes.
जर, जरथ, जरण, जरस्, &c. See p. 340.
जरठ: जरठ, अस्, आ, अम्, old, decayed, infirm; bent, bowed down, drooping; hard, solid; hard-hearted, harsh, cruel; pale, yellowish-white (the colour of old leaves); (अस्), m. decrepitude, old age; [cf. Germ. hart; Goth. hardus.]
जरण: जरण, अस्, आ, अम्, old, decayed, infirm; solvent, promoting digestion; (अस्, अम्), m. n. several medi-cinal plants or drugs used for promoting digestion, = जीरक, cumin-seed; कृष्ण-जीरक, Nigella Indica; = कास-मर्द and = कुष्ठौषधि; Asa Fœ-tida; a sort of salt, Bit-lobon or Bit-lavana; (आ), f. old age; the plant Nigella Indica; (अम्), n. old age, becoming old and infirm; one of the ten ways in which an eclipse is supposed to end. —जरण-द्रुम, अस्, m. the tree Vatica Robusta.
जरणा: जरणा 2. जरणा, f. (fr. 3. जॄ), Ved. roaring, crackling, sounding; (Sāy.) invoking, praising; [cf. 1. जरण, col. 2.]
जरणा, जरितृ, जरूथ, &c. See s. v.
जरण्ड: जरण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, decayed, old.
जरत्: जरत्, अन्, अन्ती (or अती ?), अत्, old, ancient, advanced in years, infirm, decayed; (अन्), m. an old man; (ती), f. an old woman; [cf. Gr. γέρων; Hib. gearait, ‘a saint, a holy man;’ Germ. krank ?]. —जरत्-कारु, उस्, उस्, m. f., N. of an ancient Ṛṣi of the family of Yāyāvara, and of his wife who was a sister of the ser-pent-prince Vāsuki, both being the parents of Āstīka; (उस्), m. the Vyāsa of the twenty-seventh Dvāpara. —जरत्कारु-प्रिया, f. the wife of Jarat-kāru exer-cising a peculiar power over serpents, see the preceding. —जरद्-अष्टि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. reaching to a great age, very old; (इस्), f. longevity. —जरद्-गव, अस्, m. an old bull or ox; N. of a vulture; (ई), f. an old cow; [cf. गो-जर।] —जरद्गव-वीथि, इस्, f. ‘the course of the old bull,’ N. of a part of the moon's path occupied by the constellations Vi-śākhā, Anu-rādhā, and Jyeṣṭhā. —जरद्-योषा, f. an old woman. —ज-रद्-विष्, ट्, ट्, ट्, Ved. (Sāy.) seizing on and devouring dry (wood) or consuming water (applied to Agni).
जरतिन्: जरतिन्, ई, m., N. of a man.
जरन्त: जरन्त, अस्, m. an old man; a buffalo.
जरयितृ: जरयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, consuming, devouring.
जरयु: जरयु, उस्, उस्, उ, becoming old; [cf. अ-जरयु।]
जरस्: जरस्, आ, f. (only जरस् before vowel-terminations, Gram. 171), the becoming old, decay, decrepitude, old age; (आ), m., N. of a son of Kṛṣṇa by Turī; N. of the hunter who wounded Kṛṣṇa; [cf. Gr. γῆρας.]
जरस: जरस at the end of an adv. comp. = जरस्; [cf. आ-जरसम्।]
जरा: 1. जरा, f. old age &c. See under जर, col. 2.
2. जरा, f., Ved. crackling, roaring; invoking, greeting; praise; [cf. 1. जरा above.] —जरा-बोध, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. attending to invocation or praise. —जराबोधीय, अम्, n., N. of several Sāmans.
जरायु: जरायु, उस्, उस्, उ, withering, dying away; (उ), n. the slough or cast-off skin of a serpent; the membrane which envelopes the fetus, the outer skin of the embryo or chorion, (the inner or amnion is called उल्व); after-birth, secundines; (उस्), m., N. of a plant, = अग्नि-जार; also = जटायु; (उस्), f., N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda; [cf. ज्योतिर्-जरायु and निर्-जरायु।] —जरायु-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, born from the womb, viviparous, born alive.
जरित: जरित, अस्, आ, अम्, old, decayed; (आ), f., N. of a Śārṅgikā (or kind of bird), the mother of four sons at once by the Ṛṣi Manda-pāla in the form of a male Sārṅgaka. —जरितारि (°त-अरि), इस्, m., N. of the eldest son of Manda-pāla by Jaritā.
जरिन्: जरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, old, ancient, infirm, decayed; (ई), m. an old man.
जरिमन्: जरिमन्, आ, m., Ved. old age; decrepitude, death from old age.
जरूथ: 1. जरूथ, अम्, n. skinniness, flesh flaccid with old age; flesh.
2. जरूथ, अस्, m., Ved. one who roars or makes a noise; N. of a demon conquered by Agni; (Sāy.) speaking harshly or to be invoked.
जर्जर: जर्जर, अस्, आ, अम्, old, infirm, decrepit, decayed; torn or broken in pieces, split up into small particles, divided in parts or pieces, broken; perforated, wounded, hurt; dull, hollow (as the sound of a broken vessel); (अम्), n. Indra's banner or emblem; = सैवल, an aquatic plant. —जर्जर-त्व, अम्, n. the being old or decayed or perforated &c. —जर्ज-रानना (°र-आन्°), f., N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda.
जर्जरित: जर्जरित, अस्, आ, अम्, torn in pieces, worn out.
जर्जरीक: जर्जरीक, अस्, आ, अम्, old, decayed; ragged, perforated, full of holes.
जर्जरीकृत: जर्जरी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, wounded, disabled.
जर्ण: जर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, old, decayed; (अस्), m. the (waning) moon; a tree.
जरडी: जरडी जरडी, f. a kind of grass; [cf. गर्मोटिका, जयाश्रया, सुनाला।]
जरणिप्रा: जरणि-प्रा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. moving on with noise; (Sāy.) increasing the wealth of the praiser.
जरणीय: जरणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be addressed with praise or invoked.
जरण्यु: जरण्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. invoking aloud; (Sāy.) desiring praise.
जरमाण: जरमाण, अस्, m., N. of a man.
जरितृ: जरितृ, ता, m., Ved. an invoker, singer, praiser, worshipper.
जर्च्: जर्च् जर्च्, cl. 1. 6. P. जर्चति, &c., to say, speak; to reprove, abuse, blame; to threaten.
जर्छ्: जर्छ् जर्छ्, cl. 1. 6. P. जर्च्छति, &c., to say, speak; to blame; [cf. चर्च्।]
जर्ज्: जर्ज् जर्ज्, cl. 1. 6. P. जर्जति, &c., to say; to blame, reprove; to kill or hurt (?).
जर्जित: जर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, torn to pieces, wounded; (perhaps a wrong form for जर्जरित।)
जर्झ्: जर्झ् जर्झ्, cl. 1. 6. P. जर्झति, to say or speak; to blame; to threaten; [cf. जर्च्।]
जर्त: जर्त जर्त, अस्, m. = जर्तु, q. v.
जर्तिक: जर्तिक जर्तिक, आस्, m. pl. = बाहीक।
जर्तिल: जर्तिल जर्तिल, अस्, m. wild sesamum.
जर्तु: जर्तु जर्तु, उस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. जन्), the vulva; an elephant.
जर्त्स्: जर्त्स् जर्त्स्, cl. 1. P. जर्त्सति, &c., to say, speak; to blame, censure, abuse; to protect.
जर्भरि: जर्भरि जर्भरि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. rt. भृ ?), Ved. supporting (?). According to Sāy. जर्भरी = भर्-तारौ, supporters (epithet of the Aśvins).
जर्य: जर्य जर्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. जॄ), becoming old; [cf. अ-जर्य।]
जर्वर: जर्वर जर्वर, अस्, m., N. of a priest assist-ing at a sacrifice by which the serpent-race overcame death.
जर्हिल: जर्हिल जर्हिल, अस्, m. wild sesamum; [cf. जर्तिल।]
जल्: जल् जल्, cl. 1. P. जलति, &c., to be rich or wealthy; to cover, hide, or veil; to cover as with a net, encompass; to be sharp; to be cold, stiff, dull, dumb; cl. 10. P. जालयति, -यितुम्, to cover; [cf. Lat. galea.]
जल: 1. जल, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. the preceding rt.; perhaps connected with गल्; cf. जड), cold, stupid, apathetic, idiotic; (अस्), m., N. of a man with the patronymic Jātukarṇya; (आ), f., N. of a river; (अम्), n. water, any fluid; a kind of fragrant medi-cinal plant, = ह्रीवेर; the embryo or uterus of a cow; frigidity (moral, mental, or physical); [cf. Lat. gelu; Goth. kalds; Lith. sẓala, szattas; Russ. cholodnyi; Hib. gil.] —जल-कण्टक, अस्, m. a crocodile; ‘water-thorn,’ the plant Trapa Bispinosa. —जल-कपि, इस्, m. the Gangetic porpoise, Delphinus Gangeticus (‘water-monkey’). —जल-कपोत, अस्, m. ‘water-pigeon,’ N. of a particular species of bird. —जल-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, making or pouring forth water; (अस्), m. rent or tax derived from water for fisheries &c. —जल-करङ्क, अस्, m. a shell, a conch; a cocoa-nut; a cloud; a wave; a lotus. —जल-कल्क, अस्, m. ‘water-sediment,’ mud, mire. —जल-कल्मष, अस्, m. the poison produced at the churning of the ocean. —जल-काक, अस्, m. ‘a water-crow,’ the diver bird. —जल-काङ्क्ष, अस्, m. ‘de-sirous of water,’ an elephant; [cf. जलाकाङ्क्ष।] —जल-काङ्क्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, desirous of water, fond of water; (ई), m. an elephant. —जल-कान्त, अस्, m. the wind (‘the water-lover’). —जल-कान्तार, अस्, m. a N. of Varuṇa (‘whose grove or garden is water’). —जल-कामुक, अस्, m., N. of a plant, = कुटुम्बिनी. —जल-किराट, अस्, m. (किराट for कि-रात ?), a shark or (according to some) a large alligator. —जल-कुक्कुट, अस्, m. a water-fowl or other water-bird; (ई), f. the black-headed gull; [cf. गङ्गाचिल्ली।] —जल-कुक्कुभ, अस्, m. a species of aquatic bird, = कोयष्टि. —जल-कुन्तल, अस्, m. ‘water-hair,’ N. of an aquatic plant, Blyxa Octandra; [cf. जल-केश।] —जल-कुब्जक, अस्, m., N. of an aquatic plant, Trapa Bispinosa. —जल-कूपी, f. a spring, well; pond, pool; whirlpool. —जल-कूर्म, अस्, m. the Gangetic porpoise. —जल-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, causing rain. —जल-केतु, उस्, m., N. of a particular comet. —जल-केलि, इस्, इस्, m. f. playing or gambol-ing in water, splashing one another with water. —जलकेलि-वर्णन, अम्, n. title of the third chapter of Hari-nātha's poem Rāma-vilāsa-kāvya. —जल-केश, अस्, m. ‘water-hair,’ the plant Blyxa Octandra; [cf. जल-कुन्तल।] —जल-क्रिया, f. a funeral ceremony, offering libations, presenting water to the manes of the deceased. —जल-क्रीडा, f. sport-ing or gamboling in water, bathing for pleasure or amusement; [cf. जल-केलि।] —जल-खग, अस्, m. an aquatic bird. —जल-गन्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, making the water fragrant (?) or turbid (?). —जल-गन्धे-भ, अस्, m. ‘a scented elephant frequenting water,’ N. of a species of animal. —जल-गर्भ, अस्, m., N. of a son of Jala-vāhana, = Ānanda in a former birth. —जल-गुल्म, अस्, m. a turtle, tortoise; a quadrangular tank, a piece of water; a whirlpool. —जलङ्-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, aquatic, frequenting water, going in water; (अस्), m. the colocynth (महा-काल). —जलङ्-गम, अस्, m. a Cāṇḍāla, an outcast; (a various reading for जनङ्-गम।) —जल-च-त्वर, अम्, n. a square tank. —जल-चर, अस्, ई, अम्, going in water, aquatic, amphibious; जागरूक: जागरूक, अस्, आ, अम्, wakeful, waking, sleepless, watchful.
जागर्तव्य: जागर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be awake or awaked.
जागर्ति: जागर्ति, इस्, f. waking, vigilance; keeping watch, watchfulness.
जागृतव्य: जागृतव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be awake. See जा-गर्तव्य।
जागृवि: जागृवि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. watchful, attentive; awake; not extinguished, clear, bright (as fire); active, ani-mating, exciting; (इस्), m. fire or its deity; a king.
जाग्रत्: जाग्रत्, अत्, अती, अत्, watching, being awake. —जा-ग्रत्-स्वप्न, औ, m. du. a state of waking and sleep; (अस्), m. Ved. dreaming in a waking state, day-dream, hallucination; (अस्, आ, अम्), occurring in a state of waking and sleep (?). —जाग्रद्-अवस्था or जाग्रद्-दशा, f. a state of wakefulness. —जाग्रद्-दुःष्वप्-न्य, अम्, n., Ved. a disagreeable dream or vision while in a waking state.
जाघनी: जाघनी जाघनी, f. (fr. जघन), a tail; the thigh, leg.
जाङ्गल: जाङ्गल जाङ्गल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. जङ्गल), arid; sparingly grown with trees &c. but nevertheless fertile; rural, picturesque, diversified with hill, vale, wood, and water; found or existing in such a district; desert, covered with jungle; wild, not tame (as an animal &c.); savage, barbarous; (अस्), m. the franco-line partridge; N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people; (ई), f. the plant Mucuna Pruritus; (अम्), n. flesh; game, the flesh of deer &c.
जाङ्गलि: जाङ्गलि, इस्, m. a snake-catcher; [cf. जाङ्गुलि।]
जाङ्गलिक: जाङ्गलिक, अस्, m. a snake-charmer, = जङ्गुलिक।
जाङ्गुल: जाङ्गुल, अम्, n. poison, venom, = जङ्गुल; the fruit of the Jālinī, a kind of cucumber; (ई), f. knowledge of poisons, the possession of charms or drugs and employment of them as antidotes; a pot-herb, Luffa Acutangula; an epithet of Durgā.
जाङ्गुलि: जाङ्गुलि, इस्, m. a snake-catcher, a dealer in anti-dotes, a conjuror.
जाङ्गुलिक: जाङ्गुलिक, अस्, m. a snake-catcher, a snake-doctor, one who pretends by charms to cure the bite of snakes or other venomous animals, a dealer in antidotes &c.
जाङ्घनी: जाङ्घनी जाङ्घनी, f. (fr. जङ्घा), the thigh; (perhaps a wrong form for जाघनी।)
जाङ्घाप्रहतिक: जाङ्घाप्रहतिक or जाङ्घाप्रहृतिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. जङ्घा-प्रहत or -प्रहृत), produced by a blow with the leg.
जाङ्घालायन: जाङ्घालायन, अस्, m. (fr. जङ्घाल), N. of a man.
जाङ्घि: जाङ्घि, a patronymic from Jaṅgha or metronymic from Jaṅghā.
जाङ्घिक: जाङ्घिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. जङ्घा), swift of foot, a courier; relating to or belonging to the leg; (अस्), m. a courier, a running footman, an express; a camel; a kind of antelope; [cf. कपि-जाङ्घिका।]
जाजनाग: जाजनाग जाजनाग, अस्, m., N. of a man.
जाजमत्: जाजमत् जाजमत्, अत्, अती, अत् (fr. Intens. of 1. जम्, p. 339), excessively or repeatedly devouring.
जाजल: जाजल जाजल, आस्, and जाजलिन्, इनस्, m. pl., N. of a school of the Atharva-veda.
जाजलि: जाजलि जाजलि, इस्, m., N. of a preceptor.
जाजिन्: जाजिन् जाजिन्, ई, m. a warrior, a combatant; [cf. जज् and जज।]
जाज्वल्यमान: जाज्वल्यमान जाज्वल्यमान, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. Intens. of rt. ज्वल्), shining, flaming, blazing, re-splendent, effulgent, dazzling.
जाटलि: जाटलि जाटलि, इस्, ई, m. f. the plant Big-nonia Suaveolens; (other readings have पाटलि and झाटलि।)
जाटालिका: जाटालिका जाटालिका, f. (fr. जटाल or जटा-लक), N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda.
जाटिकायन: जाटिकायन जाटिकायन, अस्, m. (fr. जटिक), N. of the author of a hymn of the Atharva-veda.
जाठर: जाठर जाठर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. जठर), stomachic, abdominal, visceral, being in the stomach or belly, relating to it, relating to the womb, e. g. जाठरोऽग्निः, the fire in the stomach, the digestive faculty, gastric juice, hunger; (अस्), m. ‘offspring of the womb,’ a child; N. of an attendant of Skanda.
जाठर्य: जाठर्य, अम्, n. morbid affection of the abdomen.
जाड्य: जाड्य जाड्य, अम्, n. (fr. जड), coldness, frigidity; stiffness, inactivity, apathy, sluggishness, in-sensibility; absence of feeling in the tongue, taste-lessness; dulness or coldness of intellect, stupidity, folly. —जाड्यारि (°य-अरि), इस्, m. ‘enemy of cold-ness,’ the citron tree.
जातक: जातक, अस्, आ, अम्, born, produced; (अस्), m. a new-born child; a mendicant; (अम्), n. = जात-कर्मन्, a ceremony performed after the birth of a child; nativity, astrological calculation of a nativity; (with Buddhists) a former birth of Śākya-muni and its history; an aggregate or a collection of similar things; [cf. चतुर्-जातक।] —जातक-ध्वनि, इस्, m. a leech. —जातक-पद्धति, इस्, f., N. of a work on nativities by Ananta; another work by Keśava. —जातक-मुक्तावली, f. title of an astrological work by Śiva-dāsa. —जातकाम्भोनिधि (°क-अम्°), इस्, m. title of an astrological work by Bhadra-bāhu.
जातायन: जातायन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Jāta.
जाति: जाति, इस्, f. birth, production; the form of existence, whether as a man or animal, which is fixed by birth; position assigned by birth; rank; family, race, lineage; kind, sort, genus, species, class, tribe, caste; the cha-racter or peculiarities of a species, the genuine or true state of anything; reduction of fractions to a common denominator; false generalization; a futile answer, a self-confuting reply; a particular figure of speech in rhetoric; a class of metres; a manner of singing; a fire-place; N. of several plants, = Jas-minum Grandiflorum; Emblica Officinalis; mace, nutmeg; [cf. अन्त्य-जाति, एक-जाति, द्वि-जाति; cf. also Lat. gens; Lith. pri-gentis.] —जाति-कोश or जाति-कोष or जाती-कोश, अम्, n. a nutmeg; (ई), f. the outer skin of the nutmeg. —जाति-त्व, अम्, n. or जाति-ता, f. distinction or nature of caste or tribe; special or generic property. —जाति-धर्म, अस्, m. the duty of caste, the law or usage of caste (e. g. sacred study is the caste-duty of the Brāhman, fight-ing of the Kṣatriya, &c.); generic or specific property. —जाति-ध्वंस, अस्, m. the loss of caste or its privileges. —जातिन्-धर, अस्, m., N. of a physician, = Śuddhodana in a former birth. —जाति-पत्त्री or जाती-पत्त्री, f. the outer skin of the nut-meg. —जाति-फल or जाती-फल, अम्, n. a nutmeg; [cf. क्षुद्रजाती-फल।] —जाति-ब्राह्मण, अस्, m. a Brāhman by birth but not by knowledge. —जाति-भ्रंश, अस्, m. loss of rank or caste. —जाति-भ्रंश-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, causing loss of caste; forbidden, improper; (अम्), n. doing an act pro-hibited to a particular caste. —जाति-भ्रष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen from caste, outcast. —जाति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, of high rank, obtaining a high position. —जाति-मह, अस्, m. birthday-festival. —जाति-मात्र, अम्, n. mere birth, position in life obtained by mere birth; caste only, but not the performance of the especial duties; species, genus. —जातिमात्रोपजीविन् (°र-उप्°), ई, इनी, इ, or जातिमात्र-जीविन्, ई, इनी, इ, (a Brāhman) who lives only by his caste (without any sacerdotal acts). —जाति-माला, f. ‘garland of the castes,’ title of a work treating of the different castes. —जाति-लक्षण, अम्, n. specific or generic distinction, characteristic, mark of tribe or caste. —जाति-वचन, अम्, n. the idea of species or genus. —जाति-वाचक, अस्, इका, अम्, expressing genus, generic (as a name). —जाति-विवेक, अस्, m. title of a literary work. —जाति-वैर, अम्, n. natural enmity, innate or instinctive hostility. —जाति-वैलक्षण्य, अम्, n. inconsistency, incompatibility, conduct or quality at variance with birth or tribe. —जाति-शब्द, अस्, m. a word expressing the idea of species or genus. —जाति-सम्पन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, sprung from a good family, belonging to a noble family. —जाति-सार, अस्, m. nutmeg. —जाति-स्मर, अस्, आ, अम्, recollecting a former existence, remembering one's condition in a former life; N. of a Tirtha. —जाति-स्मरण, अम्, n. recollection of a former existence. —जाति-स्व-भाव, अस्, m. specific or generic character or nature. —जाति-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, of low birth or descent, void of caste, outcast, having a low position. —जाती-रस, अस्, m. gum myrrh. —जात्य्-अन्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, blind from birth, born blind.
जातीय: जातीय, अस्, आ, अम् (used at the end of a compound and by native grammarians considered as an affix), relating or belonging to any species, genus, tribe, order, family, race, &c. (e. g. अश्व-जातीय, belonging to the horse-kind; वृक्ष-जातीय, belonging to trees); [cf. वि-जातीय।]
जातीयक: जातीयक, अस्, आ, अम्, = जातीय; (e. g. एवं-जाती-यक, of such a kind, of such a tribe or race.)
जात्य: जात्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to a family or caste; of the same family, related; sprung from a noble family, noble; well-born, legitimate, born of parents of the same caste, genuine (γνήσιος); best, excellent; pleasing, beautiful; (in mathematics) rectangular.
जातु: जातु जातु, ind. (fr. जन् ?; cf. जनुषा under जनुस्), at all, ever; possibly, perhaps; sometimes, some day, once, once upon a time (e. g. किं तेन जातु जातेन, what is the use at all of him born ?). जातु is said to be used in connection with the potential in the sense of ‘not allowing’ (e. g. जातु वृषलं याजयेन् न मर्षयामि, I suffer not that he should cause an outcast to sacrifice), or with a present indicative to express censure (e. g. जातु याजयति वृषलम्, ought he to cause an outcast to sacrifice ?). In the Veda when जातु stands at the beginning of a sentence the verb which follows re-tains its accent. न जातु, not at all, by no means, never; अपि जातु, perhaps, possibly; जातु-चित्, at some time or other, some day, one day. —जातू-ष्ठिर, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. eminently strong; (Sāy.) always strong; or (अस्), m., N. of a man.
जातुक: जातुक जातुक, the plant from which the Asa Fœtida is obtained; (अम्), n. Asa Fœtida; [cf. जतुक।]
जातुधान: जातुधान जातुधान, अस्, m. = यातु-धान, a Rākṣasa, an imp, ogre or goblin.
जातुष: जातुष जातुष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. जतु), made of lac or gum, covered with lac or with any artificial form or condition of it; sticky, adhesive.
जातू: जातू जातू, Ved. (Sāy.) = अशनि, a thunder-bolt. —जातू-भर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. (Sāy.) armed with the thunderbolt or nourishing created beings; [cf. जातू and जात।]
जातूकर्ण: जातूकर्ण जातूकर्ण, अस्, m. (fr. जतू-कर्ण ?), N. of an ancient preceptor; N. of a physician; and of the author of a law-book; an epithet of Śiva.
जातूकर्ण्य: जातूकर्ण्य, अस्, m., N. of several preceptors and grammarians; N. of the author of a law-book.
जान: जान जान, अम्, n. (fr. rt. जन्), Ved. pro-duction, birth, origin, birthplace; (अस्), m. a patro-nymic of Vṛśa.
जानक: जानक, अस्, m. (fr. जनक), a patronymic of Kratu-vid; also of Āya-sthūṇa; (ई), f. a patronymic of Sītā, the wife of Rāma; N. of a metre consisting of four lines of twenty-four syllables each. —जानकी-नाथ or जानकीश (°की-ईश), अस्, m. the husband of Sītā, i. e. Rāma. —जानकीनाथ-शर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a man. —जानकी-राघव, अम्, n. title of a play.
जानकि: जानकि, इस्, m. a patronymic of Kratu-jit; also of Āya-sthūṇa.
जानन्तपि: जानन्तपि, इस्, m. (fr. जनन्-तप), a patronymic of Aty-arāti.
जानपद: जानपद, अस्, m. (fr. जन-पद), one who be-longs to a country, a subject; (अस्, ई, अम्), living in the country, an inhabitant of the country (opposed to पौर, inhabiting a town); a peasant, rustic, be-longing to or suited for the inhabitants of the country; (आ), f. a popular expression; N. of a place; N. of an Apsaras.
जानपदिक: जानपदिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to a country or to the subjects of a country.
जानराज्य: जानराज्य, अम्, n. (fr. जन-राजन्), Ved. sove-reignty, supremacy.
जानवादिक: जानवादिक or जानेवादिक or जानोवादिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. जन-वाद, जने-वाद, and जनो-वाद), knowing the popular report.
जानश्रुति: जानश्रुति, इस्, m. a patronymic from Jana-śruta.
जानश्रुतेय: जानश्रुतेय, अस्, m. (fr. जन-श्रुता or जान-श्रुति), a patronymic of Aupāvi.
जानायन: जानायन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Jana.
जानार्दन: जानार्दन, अस्, m. (fr. जनार्दन), a patronymic of Pra-dyumna.
जानुक: 1. जानुक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. जन्), bringing forth. (For 2. जानुक see under जानु below.)
2. जानुक, अस्, आ, अम्, at the end of an adj. comp. = जानु, the knee (e. g. ऊर्ध्व-जानुक, having the knees raised).
जानत्: जानत् जानत्, अन्, अती, अत् (fr. rt. 1. ज्ञा), knowing, understanding, &c.
जानन्ति: जानन्ति, इस्, m., N. of a preceptor.
जानान: जानान, अस्, आ, अम्, knowing, understanding.
जानि: जानि जानि (at the end of an adj. comp. = जनि or जान for जाया), a wife (e. g. अनन्य-जानि, having no other wife); [cf. अ-जानि, अरुन्धती-ज्°, द्वि-ज्°, &c.; cf. also Goth. qvêns.]
जानु: जानु जानु, उस्, उ, m. n. (fr. rt. जन् ?), the knee; जानुभ्याम् अवनीं गम्, to fall to the ground on one's knees; [cf. Lat. genu; Gr. γόνυ; Goth. kniu; Germ. Knie; Hib. glun (?); Slav. koljeno; Lith. kiélis.] —जानु-जङ्घ, अस्, m., N. of a king. —जानु-दघ्न, अस्, ई, अम्, up to the knees. —जा-नुप्रहृतिक, अस्, ई, अम्, produced by a blow with the knee; [cf. जाङ्घाप्रहृतिक।] —जानु-फ-लक or जानु-मण्डल, अम्, n. the knee-pan or patella. —जानु-विजानु, उ, n. contracting and ex-tending the knees, a peculiar position in fighting. —जानु-सन्धि, इस्, m. the knee-joint.
जान्धित: जान्धित जान्धित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. जन and धित = हित ?), Ved. ‘agreed upon by men,’ custom-ary, usual.
जान्य: जान्य जान्य, अस्, m. (fr. जानि ?), N. of an ancient sage.
जाप: जाप जाप, अस्, m. (fr. rt. जप्), muttering, whispering, muttering prayers or telling beads, reciting passages of the Vedas &c. inaudibly; a prayer uttered in this manner; [cf. कर्ण-जाप।]
जापक: जापक, अस्, इका, अम्, muttering prayers, one who mutters prayers; relating to a muttered prayer; (अम्), n. a kind of fragrant wood; (a various reading has जायक।)
जापिन्: जापिन्, ई, इनी, इ, (at the end of an adj. comp.) re-citing in a low voice.
जाप्य: जाप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be muttered, to be repeated in a low voice; (अम्), n. a prayer to be muttered inaudibly, the muttering of prayers &c.
जापन: जापन जापन, अम्, n. (a Prākṛt form for यापन), declining, rejection, dissent; dismissing, sending away; completing, finishing.
जाबाल: जाबाल 1. जाबाल, अस्, m. (fr. जबाला), a metronymic of Mahā-śāla; also of Satya-kāma; the author of a law-book; also of a medicinal work; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a school of the Yajur-veda. —जा-बालोपनिषद् (°ल-उप्°), त्, f., N. of an Upaniṣad belonging to the Atharva-veda.
जाबाल 2. जाबाल, अस्, m. (a corruption of अजा-पाल), a goat-herd.
जाबालायन: जाबालायन, अस्, m., N. of a preceptor.
जाबालि: जाबालि, इस्, m., N. of an ancient sage; also of the author of a law-book; N. of an infidel Brāhman who was one of the priests of king Daśa-ratha and after his death tried ineffectually to shake the resolution of Rāma and induce him to take the throne offered to him by his dutiful younger brother Bharata; (his speech, which is given in Rāmāyaṇa II. 108, con-tains doctrines very similar to those of the Cārvākas or materialists.)
जाबालिन्: जाबालिन्, इनस्, m. pl., N. of a school.
जामदग्न: जामदग्न जामदग्न, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. जमद्-अग्नि), derived from or produced by Jamad-agni; (अस्), m., N. of a Catur-aha ceremony.
जामदग्निय: जामदग्निय and जामदग्नेय, a patronymic from Jamad-agni.
जामदग्न्य: जामदग्न्य, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to Jamad-agni or to his son Jāmadagnya; a patronymic; (अस्), m., N. of a Catur-aha ceremony.
जामर्य: जामर्य जामर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (Sāy.) from जा-अमर्य, making creatures immortal; but per-haps connected with a rt. जम् for चम् and used as an epithet of milk.
जामा: जामा जामा, f. (fr. rt. जन्), a daughter-in-law.
जामातृ: जा-मातृ, ता, m. (‘the maker of [new] offspring,’ or perhaps related to जामि below), a daughter's husband, a son-in-law; a husband, a lord or master; a friend; the sunflower, Heliantus Annuus; [cf. यामातृ; cf. also Lat. gener (?); Gr. γάμβρος.] —जामातृ-त्व, अम्, n. the relationship of a daughter's husband.
